articles.title: Stop recording huge rosbags: Can we capture only the exact perception frame that caused a ROS latency spike?
articles.summary: Hi everyone, Recently I have been thinking about a very practical debugging problem in ROS / ROS2 perception pipelines, especially for AMRs and mobile robots. When a robot behaves strangely in the field, the usual workflow is often: rosbag record everything.
